rules.protected_source: Compare exact Unicode code points, including compatibility characters, fullwidth numeric text and decomposed dakuten; no normalization, punctuation insertion or copy edits
rules.evidence_isolation: Do not overwrite prior QA result/images/negative specimens. W09 outputs live under qa/w09/evidence
rules.scope: Use source/DOM/PDF extraction/visual/Office-native/host-native statuses separately; historical failures remain as history
rules.availability: A check not attempted is not-checked. Unsupported only on demonstrated unsupported technology. Assisted semantic judgement is not automated certification.
